The +1 per vote bonus goes to every non-storyteller and never to the storyteller

3-player rules are applied automatically for 3 players and live in one file

criteria.verification: validate.test.ts one row per case passes

criteria.description: Storyteller rotation follows seat order and wraps
Game ends at the track length or by hand; highest total wins; ties share
